about_the_game:
Join the outcasts of Villainville in this cozy farming sim adventure, where Stardew Valley meets Shrek. Grow magic crops, tame the tiny unicorns, sneak into the night market, and befriend misfit fairy tale characters. Bonus? Find the saboteur and redeem the unredeemable.

Feature List:

  • Sleuth out the mystery behind who planted the misery mushrooms. Could it be the godfathers? The smugglers? Or a traitorous islander? In this player-choice-responsive narrative with multiple endings, finding out who is the culprit is just the beginning.

  • Indulge in hours of relaxation as you focus your farming efforts on textiles from fairytale varieties of goats, sheep, alpaca, and a demon llama. Alternatively, become the greatest breeder of the tiny darling unicorns–sometimes deadly, sometimes sweet–and see how many sets you can breed.

  • Customize your character's appearance and start a new life free from the hounding merchants' guild. Options for your new look include horns, tats, fantasy-style ears, unusual eye colors, and of course great hair and stylish clothes!

  • Craft unique upgrades for your farming tools, such as a hammer that can reveal secret doors and an axe that will fly through the air and chop down an entire swath of trees in one go.

  • Delve into the rich stories behind Batwing Island’s outcast fairytale characters to find your bond mate and form friendships that strengthen the islanders and the player character’s ability to resist the effects of the misery mushrooms.

  • Explore an open world as you uncover illusions to reveal what was hidden beneath, and unlock fascinating new areas.

  • Help the island’s smuggling underbelly and join the lore keepers’ resistance movement to combat the iron fist of the Godmothers. Help the islanders know that no matter their challenges or circumstances of their birth, they each have worth and their story matters.

  • Balance your fears with your need to destroy the misery mushrooms, as you manage the player character’s heebie-jeebie meter through anxiety-management techniques as well as crafting home-grown elixirs and befriending backup so you know you’re not alone.
